remarks: Built by ATTESA Homes, this beautifully upgraded bungalow in The Brickyard in Stony Plain backs onto a pond and offers a functional open-concept design with modern finishes throughout. The main floor features a spacious great room, dining area, and stylish kitchen with island seating, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and elegant ensuite with dual sinks. An additional bedroom or office, main floor laundry, and large windows throughout add comfort, flexibility, and plenty of natural light. The walkout basement is unfinished, offering excellent potential for future development and the opportunity to customize the space to suit your needs. Complete with a double attached garage and ideally located close to parks, trails, schools, and amenities. Builder options are available for basement development, landscaping, and additional upgrades. (id:67522)
